children: This week's focus will be back on the Reserve Bank of Australia, with two senior staff speaking. Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser and Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter are likely to comment on recent strong inflation and GDP growth data. Financial markets have priced in 1.5 interest-rate hikes before the end of the year so their level of hawkishness will be scrutinized. The most recent chatter from RBA staff has been full of warnings about inflation risks and the potential for a fourth interest-rate hike this year. (james.glynn@wsj.com; X @JamesGlynnWSJ)
